---
name: Feature or research idea
about: A new task suite, a calibration idea, or an improvement to the gate
title: "[idea] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The idea**
What you want to add or change, in a sentence or two.

**Why it matters**
What it improves - safety, coverage, discrimination, a new domain, a new provider.
If it touches the core claim, say how it relates to the open problems in
[FINDINGS.md](../../FINDINGS.md).

**Sketch (optional)**
Rough approach, files you think it touches, or an API sketch.

**Scope check**
- [ ] This keeps the rule-based aggregator rule-based, or is explicitly flagged as
      the Phase 4 learned-probe stretch (see [DESIGN.md](../../DESIGN.md))
- [ ] Results stay honestly reported (no tuning thresholds on the eval set)
